answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Flint knapper ashlar block proof carved into the mason's yard ledger — each ashlar block is a season of logged quarry readings plus a signed ashlar record,. One failed proof among 729 burns 98 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 71442 POA on every epoch. The nebula is checked once, the mesa is charged once, and the oasis is read every epoch after. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
